component.name: Project B
component.summary: A browser with a shell anyone can customise (beta)

description.p: An experiment in browser architecture: a web-based shell anyone can customise, over a small Go core that owns every decision, and Chromium's content layer, unpatched.

This is a beta for Linux on arm64. It follows the desktop's dark mode, updates itself, shows notifications and opens downloads in the desktop's own apps. Printing, and what needs the person checked first, such as showing a saved password or using a passkey, are still to come.

description.p: Beta: Project B on Linux, with notifications, downloads opened in the desktop's own apps, and Settings knowing when it is the default browser.
